description: Thirty claims about the synthetic webforms-shop fixture, labelled by hand: supported when the cited lines (with the three lines of margin the verifier sees) show what the claim says, not supported when they contradict it or do not show it.

claims.text: The details page reads the item id from the request (query string, form fields or cookies) and loads the item through the catalogue service.
claims.note: Line 10 parses Request["id"] and calls CatalogService.Get.

claims.text: The details page shows the item's name and its price formatted as currency.
claims.note: Lines 11-12 set NameLabel and PriceLabel, the price with the C format.

claims.text: The quantity on the details page must be a whole number from 1 to 10; otherwise the page shows 'Quantity must be between 1 and 10.'
claims.note: A RangeValidator with minimum 1, maximum 10, type Integer and that message.

claims.text: Clicking 'Add to basket' does nothing when the page is not valid.
claims.note: The handler returns when Page.IsValid is false.

claims.text: After a line is added to the basket, the user is sent to the checkout page.
claims.note: Line 19 redirects to ~/Orders/Checkout.aspx.

claims.text: The basket is kept in the session under the key 'Basket'.
claims.note: Session["Basket"] is assigned.

claims.text: The home page fills the catalogue grid only on the first load, not on a postback.
claims.note: BindGrid is called only when IsPostBack is false.

claims.text: A search removes the spaces around the typed text before it filters the catalogue.
claims.note: SearchBox.Text.Trim() is passed to BindGrid.

claims.text: Choosing the 'Details' command on a grid row opens the details page of that row's item.
claims.note: The redirect carries the command argument as the id.

claims.text: The checkout page requires an e-mail address.
claims.note: A RequiredFieldValidator on EmailBox with the message 'E-mail is required.'

claims.text: An e-mail address is accepted only when it has one or more characters other than '@', then an '@', then one or more characters other than '@'.
claims.note: The validation expression is ^[^@]+@[^@]+$.

claims.text: When the basket is empty at checkout, the user is sent back to the home page.
claims.note: A null basket redirects to ~/Default.aspx.

claims.text: Placing an order empties the basket in the session.
claims.note: Session["Basket"] is set to null after Place.

claims.text: Express shipping adds a fee of 12 to the order number and every other shipping method adds a fee of 4.
claims.note: A conditional expression on shipping == "express".

claims.text: The basket is a list in which each line holds an item id and a quantity.
claims.note: A List<int[]> to which new[] { itemId, quantity } is added.

claims.text: The quantity is not limited from 1 to 10 but from 1 to 100.
claims.note: The maximum is 10; the claim contradicts the line.

claims.text: The search on the home page ignores upper and lower case.
claims.note: The lines pass the trimmed text on; they say nothing about case.

claims.text: The checkout page asks for the customer's postal address.
claims.note: The form has an e-mail box and a shipping list, no address.

claims.text: Placing an order sends a confirmation e-mail to the customer.
claims.note: The e-mail is passed to Place; nothing sends a message.

claims.text: Orders are saved in a database table when they are placed.
claims.note: Place only computes a number.

claims.text: Standard shipping costs 12 and express shipping costs 4.
claims.note: The fees are the other way round.

claims.text: The details page sends users who are not signed in to the login page.
claims.note: Nothing checks who the user is.

claims.text: The home page fills the catalogue grid on every request, including postbacks.
claims.note: The condition skips the binding on a postback.

claims.text: The basket is stored in a browser cookie.
claims.note: It is stored in the session.

claims.text: The confirmation page loads the order from the database by its number.
claims.note: It only prints the number from the query string.

claims.text: Checkout checks the chosen shipping method against a list of allowed values and refuses any other.
claims.note: The selected value is passed on unchecked.

claims.text: A discount is applied to baskets of more than five items.
claims.note: AddToBasket applies no discount.

claims.text: The catalogue service returns the items whose name contains the search term.
claims.note: Find returns an empty list whatever the term.

claims.text: An invalid e-mail address empties the basket.
claims.note: When the page is not valid the handler returns before the basket is touched.

claims.text: The details page shows a 'not found' message for an unknown item id.
claims.note: The item is used without any check.
